signature: SUBROUTINE DGELSS( M, N, NRHS, A, LDA, B, LDB, S, RCOND, RANK,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrices B and X. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix A. On exit, the first min(m,n) rows of A are overwritten with its right singular vectors, stored rowwise.
params.workDependent: on exit A's right singular vectors are determined only up to sign, and which ones LWORK's path returns differs; its other rows are scratch

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-`NRHS` right hand side matrix B. On exit, B is overwritten by the N-by-`NRHS` solution matrix X. If $m \ge n$ and `RANK = n`, the residual sum-of-squares for the solution in the i-th column is given by the sum of squares of elements n+1:m in that column.
params.workDependent: when M > N its rows N..M-1 hold the residual in a basis that depends on the path LWORK selects; only their sum of squares is defined

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,\max (M,N))$.

params.name: s
params.reference: The singular values of A in decreasing order. The condition number of A in the $2-\mathrm{norm} = S(1)/S(\min (m,n))$.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: `RCOND` is used to determine the effective rank of A. Singular values $S(i) \le \mathrm{RCOND} \, S(1)$ are treated as zero. If $\mathrm{RCOND} < 0$, machine precision is used instead.

params.name: rank
params.reference: The effective rank of A, i.e., the number of singular values which are greater than $\mathrm{RCOND} \, S(1)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 1$, and also: $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 3 \, \min (M,N) + \max ( 2 \, \min (M,N), \max (M,N), \mathrm{NRHS} )$ For good performance, `LWORK` should generally be larger.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: the algorithm for computing the SVD failed to converge; if `INFO = i`, i off-diagonal elements of an intermediate bidiagonal form did not converge to zero.

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local MINWRK is assigned inside nested control flow

overrides.reason: DGELSS picks its path (QR first, LQ first, or direct bidiagonalization) from LWORK. On exit A holds the right singular vectors in its first min(M,N) rows, but singular vectors are determined only up to sign (and within the subspace of a repeated singular value), so a different path can return different ones; the remaining rows are scratch. Rows N..M-1 of B, when M > N, carry the residual, which the reference defines only through its sum of squares ("the residual sum-of-squares ... is given by the sum of squares of elements n+1:m"), in a basis that depends on the path. S, RANK and rows 1..N of B (the solution) do not depend on LWORK; the module's tests check the solution at the minimum WORK (ticket 0096).

set.params.B.workDependent: when M > N its rows N..M-1 hold the residual in a basis that depends on the path LWORK selects; only their sum of squares is defined
